<object Name="Canteen" Inherits="WaterContainer">
    <part Name="LiquidVolume" MaxVolume="64" Volume="64" StartVolume="1d65-1" InitialLiquid="water-1000" ManualSeal="true" />
    <part Name="Render" DisplayName="canteen" ColorString="&g" TileColor="&g" DetailColor="w" Tile="Items/sw_canteen.png" />
    <part Name="Description" Short="A jug of aluminum has been sheathed in an olive green cloth for waterkeeping." />
    <property Name="SparkingQuestBlueprint" Value="Canteen" />
  </object>

<object Name="WaterContainer" Inherits="Item">
    <part Name="LiquidVolume" MaxVolume="64" Volume="0" />
    <part Name="Render" DisplayName="[Water Container]" ColorString="&b" RenderString="168" RenderLayer="5" Tile="Items/sw_waterskin.bmp" TileColor="&w" DetailColor="y" />
    <part Name="Physics" Category="Water Containers" SpecificHeat="4.1813" />
    <part Name="LeakWhenBroken" />
    <part Name="Commerce" Value="5" />
    <part Name="NotNameable" />
    <part Name="LiquidRepellent" Liquids="water,cider,goo,oil,ooze,proteangunk,slime,sludge,wine" />
    <stat Name="Hitpoints" Value="30" sValue="30" />
	  <tag Name="EquipSound" Value="sfx_equip_material_liquidContainer" />
    <tag Name="WaterContainer" Value="1" />
    <tag Name="BaseObject" Value="*noinherit" />
		<stag Name="Storage" />
  </object>

<object Name="Item" Inherits="InorganicObject">
    <part Name="Render" DisplayName="[Item]" RenderString="." RenderLayer="5" />
    <part Name="Physics" Conductivity="20" />
    <tag Name="OverlayColor" Value="&Y^k" />
    <part Name="Stacker" />
    <part Name="MentalShield" />
	  <tag Name="EquipSound" Value="sfx_equip_material_generic_organic" />
	  <tag Name="UnequipSound" Value="sfx_unequip_material" />
    <tag Name="BaseObject" Value="*noinherit" />
    <tag Name="TinkerCategory" Value="utility" />
    <tag Name="Item" />
    <tag Name="DynamicObjectsTable:Items" />
  </object>

<object Name="InorganicObject" Inherits="PhysicalObject">
    <part Name="Inorganic" />
    <stat Name="DV" Value="-20" />
    <part Name="Physics" Organic="false" />
    <tag Name="Gender" Value="neuter" />
    <tag Name="BaseObject" Value="*noinherit" />
    <tag Name="Breakable" />
  </object>

<object Name="PhysicalObject" Inherits="Object">
    <part Name="Render" DisplayName="[Object]" RenderString="?" RenderLayer="1" RenderIfDark="true" />
    <part Name="Physics" Category="Miscellaneous" IsReal="true" Solid="false" Weight="1" />
    <part Name="MeleeWeapon" BaseDamage="1d2" Stat="Strength" Skill="Cudgel" />
    <part Name="Commerce" Value="0.01" />
    <part Name="Description" Short="A hideous specimen." />
    <part Name="BurnToAshesIfOrganic" />
    <stat Name="Hitpoints" ShortName="HP" Min="0" Max="64000" Value="25" />
    <stat Name="AV" ShortName="AV" Min="0" Max="100" Value="2" />
    <stat Name="DV" ShortName="DV" Min="-100" Max="100" Value="0" />
    <tag Name="BaseObject" Value="*noinherit" />
    <tag Name="Category" Value="object" />    
  </object>
